name: @lola-market/skills-alpha
stderr:
Usage: lola [options] [command]

LOLA market CLI — one binary, one subcommand per skill.

Each skill is a narrow capability bundle authorized via the OAuth
device flow. Tokens live at $LOLA_CREDENTIALS_FILE (default
~/.config/lola/credentials.json, mode 0600). Base URL is
$LOLA_BASE_URL (default https://staging.lola.market).

Discoverable workflow:
  1. `lola login` — pair all skills with one approval click
  2. `lola whoami` — confirm which human you are acting as
  3. `lola <skill> --help` — see what the skill can do
  4. For state-machine actions (e.g. rentals.advance) call the
     skill's `events <id>` first to discover allowed transitions,
     then `advance <id> <event>` with the right payload flags.
  5. On any 4xx, read the JSON error body — the proxy returns a
     `code` like EVENT_BLOCKED_FOR_SKILL / NOT_FOUND / WRONG_SKILL.

MCP: the same operations are exposed over stdio JSON-RPC by the
`lola-mcp` binary. Point your MCP host (Claude Desktop, Claude
Code, Cursor, opencode, …) at it; it reads the same credentials
file this CLI writes, so `lola login` once and both work.

Options:
  -V, --version     output the version number
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]   Pair this CLI with your LOLA account via the device flow.
  whoami [options]  Show who this CLI is paired to, per skill.
  logout [options]  Drop locally-stored tokens for a skill (or all skills).
  onboard           Create new listings (onboard-item skill).
  
                    Two steps: upload photos → create. The `upload` subcommand
                    reads files from disk on the host running this CLI (also
                    works under stdio MCP — Claude Desktop, Claude Code,
                    Cursor, …).
  items             List / view / edit / soft-delete your own listings
                    (manage-items skill).
  
                    Reads use native CRUD narrowed by scope_shadow_data to your
                    user_created. Writes (edit, delete) go through
                    /skill-onboard proxy endpoints.
  messages          List conversations, read/send messages, mark as read
                    (manage-messages skill).
  
                    Only 1:1 listing-bound chats in v1; group conversations are
                    out of scope.
  groups            List groups, memberships, invites; accept/decline invites
                    (manage-groups skill).
  
                    v1 is read + invite responses only — no
                    create/invite/kick/promote.
  rentals           Manage your LOLA rentals (manage-rentals skill).
  
  Read scope is automatically narrowed to rentals where you are the
  renter or the owner (scope_shadow_data hook).
  
  For state-machine actions: call `events <id>` to discover what is
  allowed for you given the rental's current state, then `advance
  <id> <event>` with the right payload flags.
  
  Money-adjacent FSM events are refused at the proxy and are not
  callable from this CLI:
    reports_damage, reports_theft, request_damage_report
  Use the LOLA app for those.
  browse            Search and view active marketplace listings
                    (browse-listings skill).
  
                    Reads any user's active listings, plus category / attribute
                    facets.
                    Never sees drafts, deletion-pending rows, or other users'
                    PII.
                    No writes — to rent something, use a separate flow.
  help [command]    display help for command

Examples:
  $ lola login                              # all skills, one approval
  $ lola login --skill manage-rentals       # just one skill
  $ lola whoami                             # who am I per skill?
  $ lola rentals list --status request_submitted
  $ lola rentals events <id>                # discover what's possible
  $ lola rentals advance <id> confirm_request
  $ lola logout --all
